description: Structured extraction schema for migrating regulatory identifiers, referenced standards, and quantitative analytical/clinical performance results from an FDA 510(k) decision summary. Use this schema to compare independent extractions of the same document field-by-field without relying on narrative prose.

alert_performance.description: One object for each threshold-setting row in the hypoglycemic and hyperglycemic alert and detection tables. Use the table title to identify alert type, population, wear location, and subject count.

alert_count_n.description: The integer printed under # of alerts (n) for the row. Strip commas; emit as an integer; null is not allowed.

alert_setting_mg_dl.description: The integer threshold printed in the Alert Setting (mg/dL) column for the row. Emit the integer only without units, commas, or a trailing .0; null is not allowed.

alert_type.description: The alert category named in the table title. Use the short category word from the title; preserve exact printed capitalization; null is not allowed.

event_count_n.description: The integer printed under # of events (n) for the row. Strip commas; emit as an integer; null is not allowed.

false_alert_percent.description: The number printed under False Alert (%) for the row. Emit the percent number only without the percent sign; null is not allowed.

missed_detection_percent.description: The number printed under Missed Detection (%) for the row. Emit the percent number only without the percent sign; null is not allowed.

population_age_group.description: The population age group printed in the alert table title. Preserve comparison symbols, hyphens, digits, and capitalization; collapse repeated whitespace to a single space; null is not allowed.

subjects_n.description: The subject count printed in parentheses in the alert table title. Emit the integer only, without the leading letter, parentheses, commas, or trailing .0; null is not allowed.

true_alert_percent.description: The number printed under True Alert (%) for the row. Emit the percent number only without the percent sign; null is not allowed.

true_detection_percent.description: The number printed under True Detection (%) for the row. Emit the percent number only without the percent sign; null is not allowed.

wear_location.description: The wear-location label printed in the alert table title. Preserve exact printed capitalization; collapse repeated whitespace to a single space; null is not allowed.

applicant_name.description: The value printed in the Background Information subsection labeled Applicant. Preserve exact printed capitalization and punctuation; collapse repeated whitespace to a single space; null is not allowed.

classification_panel.description: The panel text printed in the Regulatory Information table under the Classification Panel column. Preserve exact printed capitalization and punctuation; collapse repeated whitespace to a single space; null is not allowed.

concurrence_marginal_totals.description: One object for each printed marginal total in the concurrence matrices, including row totals when the table prints a Total column and column totals when the table prints a Total row.

glucose_range_mg_dl.description: The glucose range label for the marginal total, taken from the row label for row totals or the column header for column totals. Preserve comparison signs and hyphens; remove units because the field name supplies them; collapse whitespace; null is not allowed.

percentage_basis.description: The basis indicated by the concurrence table title after the word "by" and before the population/location segment. Transcribe the full printed glucose-range basis phrase from that title, preserving capitalization and including descriptor words that are part of the phrase; do not shorten it to only the device or comparator name; null is not allowed.

population_age_group.description: The population age group printed in the concurrence table title. Preserve comparison symbols, hyphens, digits, and capitalization; collapse repeated whitespace to a single space; null is not allowed.

subjects_n.description: The subject count printed in parentheses in the concurrence table title. Emit the integer only, without the leading letter, parentheses, commas, or trailing .0; null is not allowed.

total_axis.description: The printed matrix axis whose margin supplies this total: for totals at the end of matrix rows, use the row-axis heading at the left of the table; for totals in the bottom Total row, use the column-axis heading above the glucose-range columns. Preserve the printed axis wording and capitalization, including descriptor words that are part of the heading, but remove unit-only lines such as parenthesized units; null is not allowed.

total_count_n.description: The printed marginal total count for this glucose range. Strip commas; emit as an integer; null is not allowed.

wear_location.description: The wear-location label printed in the concurrence table title. Preserve exact printed capitalization; collapse repeated whitespace to a single space; null is not allowed.

concurrence_matrix_cells.description: One object for each populated count-and-percent cell in each concurrence matrix comparing iCGM glucose ranges with comparator glucose ranges. Do not create objects for visibly blank matrix cells or marginal total cells.

comparator_glucose_range_mg_dl.description: The comparator glucose range column header for the matrix cell. Preserve comparison signs and hyphens; remove units because the field name supplies them; collapse whitespace; null is not allowed.

icgm_glucose_range_mg_dl.description: The iCGM glucose range row label for the matrix cell. Preserve comparison signs and hyphens; remove units because the field name supplies them; collapse whitespace; null is not allowed.

pair_count_n.description: The integer count printed in the matrix cell above or adjacent to the percentage for this row-column intersection. Strip commas; emit as an integer; null is not allowed.

percentage.description: The percentage printed in the matrix cell for this row-column intersection. Strip parentheses and the percent sign; emit zero as 0 when printed; null is not allowed.

percentage_basis.description: The basis indicated by the concurrence table title after the word "by" and before the population/location segment. Transcribe the full printed glucose-range basis phrase from that title, preserving capitalization and including descriptor words that are part of the phrase; do not shorten it to only the device or comparator name; null is not allowed.

population_age_group.description: The population age group printed in the concurrence table title. Preserve comparison symbols, hyphens, digits, and capitalization; collapse repeated whitespace to a single space; null is not allowed.

subjects_n.description: The subject count printed in parentheses in the concurrence table title. Emit the integer only, without the leading letter, parentheses, commas, or trailing .0; null is not allowed.

wear_location.description: The wear-location label printed in the concurrence table title. Preserve exact printed capitalization; collapse repeated whitespace to a single space; null is not allowed.

data_availability_by_wear_day.description: One object for each wear-day or overall row in the data availability rate table. Use the first column exactly to distinguish numbered days from the overall summary row.

data_availability_rate_percent.description: The number printed in the Data Availability Rate (%) column for the row. Emit the percent number only without the percent sign; null is not allowed.

number_of_sensors.description: The integer printed in the Number of Sensors column for the row. Strip commas; emit as an integer; null is not allowed.

wear_day_label.description: The label printed in the Wear Day column. For numbered days, emit the digits as a string; for a summary row, preserve the exact printed capitalization; collapse repeated whitespace to a single space; null is not allowed.

detailed_accuracy_by_glucose_range.description: One object for each glucose-range row in the system accuracy tables that include 15/20/40 mg/dL, 15/20/40 percent, mean bias, and MARD. Use the table title to identify the range basis, population, and wear location.

glucose_range_mg_dl.description: The glucose range label printed in the first column for the row. Preserve comparison signs and hyphens; remove units because the field name supplies them; collapse whitespace; null is not allowed.

mard_percent.description: The number printed under MARD (%) for this row. Emit the percent number only without the percent sign; null is not allowed.

matched_pairs_n.description: The integer printed under Matched Pairs (N) for this row. Strip commas; emit as an integer; null is not allowed.

mean_bias_mg_dl.description: The number printed under Mean Bias (mg/dL) for this row. Preserve the negative sign when printed; emit the number only without units; null is not allowed.

population_age_group.description: The population age group printed in the table title. Preserve comparison symbols, hyphens, digits, and capitalization; collapse repeated whitespace to a single space; null is not allowed.

range_basis.description: The measurement basis named in the table title after "Within" and before the population/location segment. Transcribe the full printed glucose-range basis phrase from that title, preserving capitalization and including descriptor words that are part of the phrase; do not shorten it to only the device or comparator name; null is not allowed.

subjects_n.description: The subject count printed in parentheses in the table title. Emit the integer only, without the leading letter, parentheses, commas, or trailing .0; null is not allowed.

wear_location.description: The wear-location label printed in the table title. Preserve exact printed capitalization; collapse repeated whitespace to a single space; null is not allowed.

within_15_mg_dl_percent.description: The percent number in the Percent Within 15 mg/dL column for this row. Emit null only when the cell is a dash placeholder; strip percent signs if present.

within_15_percent_percent.description: The percent number in the Percent Within 15% column for this row. Emit null only when the cell is a dash placeholder; strip percent signs.

within_20_mg_dl_percent.description: The percent number in the Percent Within 20 mg/dL column for this row. Emit null only when the cell is a dash placeholder; strip percent signs if present.

within_20_percent_percent.description: The percent number in the Percent Within 20% column for this row. Emit null only when the cell is a dash placeholder; strip percent signs.

within_40_mg_dl_percent.description: The percent number in the Percent Within 40 mg/dL column for this row. Emit null only when the cell is a dash placeholder; strip percent signs if present.

within_40_percent_percent.description: The percent number in the Percent Within 40% column for this row. Emit null only when the cell is a dash placeholder; strip percent signs.

device_classification.description: The classification text printed in the Regulatory Information table under the Classification column. Preserve the class wording as printed; collapse repeated whitespace to a single space; null is not allowed.

grace_period_hours.description: The numeric extended grace period printed with the sensor wear period in the device description text. Emit the number of hours only, without the word hours; use an integer-valued JSON number when the printed value is an integer; null is not allowed.

low_high_reading_distribution.description: One object for each comparator-threshold column in the distribution table for iCGM readings displayed as LOW or HIGH. Exclude the Total column from this array and capture it in the totals array.

comparator_pairs_n.description: The integer count printed in the n row for this iCGM reading group and comparator threshold. Strip commas; emit as an integer; null is not allowed.

comparator_threshold_direction.description: The comparison symbol printed in the comparator threshold column header for this value. Preserve the printed symbol exactly; do not replace it with words; null is not allowed.

comparator_threshold_mg_dl.description: The numeric threshold printed in the comparator threshold column header. Emit the integer only, without comparison symbols, units, commas, or a trailing .0; null is not allowed.

cumulative_percent.description: The number printed in the Cumulative Percent row for this iCGM reading group and comparator threshold. Strip percent signs if present; emit zero as 0 when printed; null is not allowed.

icgm_reading_label.description: The iCGM reading label printed at the start of the row group. Preserve exact printed capitalization; collapse repeated whitespace to a single space; null is not allowed.

subjects_n.description: The subject count printed in parentheses in the distribution table title. Emit the integer only, without the leading letter, parentheses, commas, or trailing .0; null is not allowed.

low_high_reading_totals.description: One object for each Total column value printed for an iCGM LOW or HIGH reading group in the distribution table.

icgm_reading_label.description: The iCGM reading label printed at the start of the row group. Preserve exact printed capitalization; collapse repeated whitespace to a single space; null is not allowed.

total_comparator_pairs_n.description: The integer printed in the Total column of the n row for this iCGM reading group. Strip commas; emit as an integer; null is not allowed.

measurand.description: The value printed in the Submission/Device Overview subsection labeled Measurand. Preserve exact printed capitalization; collapse repeated whitespace to a single space; null is not allowed.

overall_twenty_percent_accuracy.description: One object for each population/wear-location row in the summary table reporting percent of iCGM values within 20% of comparator glucose.

matched_pairs_n.description: The integer printed under Matched Pairs (n). Strip commas; emit as an integer; null is not allowed.

patient_population.description: The patient population label printed in the first column. Preserve exact printed capitalization, digits, comparison symbols, and parenthetical age text; collapse repeated whitespace to a single space; null is not allowed.

percent_within_20_95_lb_percent.description: The number inside parentheses in the Percent within 20% (95% LB) cell. Strip parentheses and percent signs; null is not allowed.

percent_within_20_percent.description: The number before parentheses in the Percent within 20% column. Emit the percent number only without the percent sign; null is not allowed.

wear_location.description: The wear-location label printed on the same row. Preserve exact printed capitalization; collapse repeated whitespace to a single space; null is not allowed.

point_accuracy_by_glucose_range.description: One object for each glucose-range row in the percent-and-point accuracy tables. Use the table title to determine whether the range basis is iCGM or comparator, then read all metrics from that row.

glucose_range_mg_dl.description: The glucose range label printed in the first column for the row. Preserve comparison signs and hyphens; remove units because the field name supplies them; collapse whitespace; null is not allowed.

matched_pairs_n.description: The integer printed under Matched Pairs (N) for this row. Strip commas; emit as an integer; null is not allowed.

mean_bias_95_ub_mg_dl.description: The number inside parentheses in the Mean Bias (mg/dL) (95% UB) cell for this row. Preserve the negative sign when printed; strip parentheses and units; null is not allowed.

mean_bias_mg_dl.description: The number before parentheses in the Mean Bias (mg/dL) column for this row. Preserve the negative sign when printed; emit the number only without units; null is not allowed.

population_age_group.description: The population age group printed in the table title. Preserve comparison symbols, hyphens, digits, and capitalization; collapse repeated whitespace to a single space; null is not allowed.

range_basis.description: The measurement basis named in the table title after the word "by" and before the population/location segment. Transcribe the full printed glucose-range basis phrase from that title, preserving capitalization and including descriptor words that are part of the phrase; do not shorten it to only the device or comparator name; null is not allowed.

subjects_n.description: The subject count printed in parentheses in the table title. Emit the integer only, without the leading letter, parentheses, commas, or a trailing .0; null is not allowed.

wear_location.description: The wear-location label printed in the table title. Preserve exact printed capitalization; collapse repeated whitespace to a single space; null is not allowed.

within_15_mg_dl_95_lb_percent.description: The number inside parentheses in the Percent Within 15 mg/dL (95% LB) cell for this row. Emit null only when the corresponding cell is a dash placeholder; strip parentheses and percent signs.

within_15_mg_dl_percent.description: The percent number before parentheses in the Percent Within 15 mg/dL column for this row. Emit null only when the cell is a dash placeholder indicating not applicable; never emit a dash string; strip the percent sign if present.

within_15_percent_95_lb_percent.description: The number inside parentheses in the Percent Within 15% (95% LB) cell for this row. Emit null only when the corresponding cell is a dash placeholder; strip parentheses and percent signs.

within_15_percent_percent.description: The percent number before parentheses in the Percent Within 15% column for this row. Emit null only when the cell is a dash placeholder indicating not applicable; never emit a dash string; strip percent signs.

within_40_mg_dl_95_lb_percent.description: The number inside parentheses in the Percent Within 40 mg/dL (95% LB) cell for this row. Emit null only when the corresponding cell is a dash placeholder; strip parentheses and percent signs.

within_40_mg_dl_percent.description: The percent number before parentheses in the Percent Within 40 mg/dL column for this row. Emit null only when the cell is a dash placeholder indicating not applicable; never emit a dash string; strip the percent sign if present.

within_40_percent_95_lb_percent.description: The number inside parentheses in the Percent Within 40% (95% LB) cell for this row. Emit null only when the corresponding cell is a dash placeholder; strip parentheses and percent signs.

within_40_percent_percent.description: The percent number before parentheses in the Percent Within 40% column for this row. Emit null only when the cell is a dash placeholder indicating not applicable; never emit a dash string; strip percent signs.

precision_by_insertion_site_age.description: One object for each population and insertion-site column in the precision table. Read each value from the intersection of the printed metric row and the population/site column.

cgm_cgm_matched_pairs_n.description: The integer in the row labeled CGM-CGM Matched Pairs (n) for this population/site column. Strip commas and units; emit as an integer; null is not allowed.

coefficient_of_variation_percent.description: The numeric value in the row labeled Coefficient of Variation (%) for this population/site column. Emit the percent number only, without the percent sign; null is not allowed.

number_of_subjects_n.description: The integer in the row labeled Number of Subjects (N) for this population/site column. Emit as an integer without commas or a trailing .0; null is not allowed.

paired_absolute_difference_mg_dl.description: The numeric value in the row labeled Paired Absolute Difference (mg/dL) for this population/site column. Emit the number only without units; null is not allowed.

paired_absolute_relative_difference_perc.description: The numeric value in the row labeled Paired Absolute Relative Difference (%) for this population/site column. Emit the percent number only, without the percent sign; null is not allowed.

population_age_group.description: The age-group header printed above the column. Preserve comparison symbols, hyphens, digits, and capitalization; collapse repeated whitespace to a single space; null is not allowed.

wear_location.description: The insertion-site or wear-location label printed under the age-group header for the column. Preserve the site-name capitalization and words, collapse repeated whitespace to a single space, and remove footnote markers or callout symbols attached to the label; null is not allowed.

predicate_510k_number.description: The value printed in the Substantial Equivalence Information subsection labeled Predicate 510(k) Number(s). Preserve exact printed capitalization and digits; collapse repeated whitespace to a single space; null is not allowed.

predicate_device_name.description: The value printed in the Substantial Equivalence Information subsection labeled Predicate Device Name(s). Join wrapped lines with a single space if wrapping occurs; preserve exact printed capitalization and punctuation; null is not allowed.

product_code.description: The product code printed in the Regulatory Information table under the Product Code(s) column. Preserve exact printed capitalization; strip surrounding whitespace; null is not allowed.

proprietary_established_name.description: The value printed in the Background Information subsection labeled Proprietary and Established Names. Join wrapped lines with a single space if wrapping occurs; preserve exact printed capitalization and punctuation; null is not allowed.

regulation_section.description: The regulation citation printed in the Regulatory Information table under the Regulation Section column. Preserve the CFR citation text as printed, including spaces; collapse repeated whitespace to a single space; null is not allowed.

reportable_high_mg_dl.description: The upper numeric endpoint of the reportable glucose range printed in the device characteristics or linearity/reportable range text. Emit the integer only, without units, commas, comparison symbols, or a trailing .0; null is not allowed.

reportable_low_mg_dl.description: The lower numeric endpoint of the reportable glucose range printed in the device characteristics or linearity/reportable range text. Emit the integer only, without units, commas, comparison symbols, or a trailing .0; null is not allowed.

sensor_stability_by_wear_period.description: One object for each wear-period row in the sensor stability accuracy table.

mard_percent.description: The number printed under MARD (%) for the row. Emit the percent number only without the percent sign; null is not allowed.

matched_pairs_n.description: The integer printed under Matched Pairs (n) for the row. Strip commas; emit as an integer; null is not allowed.

wear_period_label.description: The wear-period label printed in the first column. Preserve exact printed capitalization; collapse repeated whitespace to a single space; null is not allowed.

within_15_15_percent.description: The number printed under the %15/15 column for the row. Emit the percent number only without the percent sign; null is not allowed.

within_20_20_percent.description: The number printed under the %20/20 column for the row. Emit the percent number only without the percent sign; null is not allowed.

within_40_40_percent.description: The number printed under the %40/40 column for the row. Emit the percent number only without the percent sign; null is not allowed.

sensor_survival_by_day.description: One object for each day-of-wear row in each system survival table. Use the table title to identify population, wear location, and the denominator printed in parentheses.

number_of_sensors_n.description: The integer printed in the Number of Sensors column for the row. Strip commas; emit as an integer; null is not allowed.

population_age_group.description: The population age group printed in the survival table title. Preserve comparison symbols, hyphens, digits, and capitalization; collapse repeated whitespace to a single space; null is not allowed.

sensor_denominator_n.description: The sensor denominator printed in parentheses in the survival table title. Emit the integer only, without the leading letter, parentheses, commas, or trailing .0; null is not allowed.

survival_rate_percent.description: The number printed in the Survival Rate (%) column for the row. Emit the percent number only without the percent sign; null is not allowed.

wear_day.description: The integer printed in the Day of Wear column for the row. Emit as an integer without units or trailing .0; null is not allowed.

wear_location.description: The wear-location label printed in the survival table title. Preserve exact printed capitalization; collapse repeated whitespace to a single space; null is not allowed.

sensor_wear_days.description: The numeric expected sensor wear period printed in the device description text. Emit the number of days only, without the word days; use an integer-valued JSON number when the printed value is an integer; null is not allowed.

standards_referenced.description: One object for each numbered standard or guidance document listed in the Standards/Guidance Documents Referenced section. Exclude the descriptive title after the first comma so that each row contains only deterministic short reference data.

sequence_number.description: The leading list number printed before the standard reference. Emit as an integer without punctuation; null is not allowed.

standard_reference_code.description: The standard or guidance reference text after the list number and before the first comma in the same list item. Preserve exact printed capitalization, slashes, hyphens, colons, and date punctuation; collapse repeated whitespace to a single space; null is not allowed.

submission_510k_number.description: The value printed in the Background Information subsection labeled 510(k) Number. Preserve the exact printed capitalization and digits; collapse internal whitespace to a single space; null is not allowed.

test_type.description: The value printed in the Submission/Device Overview subsection labeled Type of Test. Preserve exact printed capitalization and parenthetical text; collapse repeated whitespace to a single space; null is not allowed.

trend_accuracy_matrix_cells.description: One object for each cell in each trend accuracy matrix comparing iCGM rate range with comparator rate range. Read the count and row percentage from the same row-column intersection.

comparator_rate_range_mg_dl_per_min.description: The comparator rate range column header for the matrix cell. Preserve brackets, parentheses, comparison signs, commas, minus signs, and spacing as printed after collapsing repeated whitespace; remove units because the field name supplies them; null is not allowed.

icgm_rate_range_mg_dl_per_min.description: The iCGM rate range row label for the matrix cell. Preserve brackets, parentheses, comparison signs, commas, minus signs, and spacing as printed after collapsing repeated whitespace; remove units because the field name supplies them; null is not allowed.

pair_count_n.description: The integer count printed in the matrix cell for this row-column intersection. Strip commas; emit as an integer; null is not allowed.

population_age_group.description: The population age group printed in the trend accuracy table title. Preserve comparison symbols, hyphens, digits, and capitalization; collapse repeated whitespace to a single space; null is not allowed.

row_percent.description: The row percentage printed in parentheses in the matrix cell for this row-column intersection. Strip parentheses and the percent sign; emit zero as 0 when printed; null is not allowed.

subjects_n.description: The subject count printed in parentheses in the trend accuracy table title. Emit the integer only, without the leading letter, parentheses, commas, or trailing .0; null is not allowed.

wear_location.description: The wear-location label printed in the trend accuracy table title. Preserve exact printed capitalization; collapse repeated whitespace to a single space; null is not allowed.

trend_accuracy_row_totals.description: One object for each row-total cell in each trend accuracy matrix. These totals are printed in the rightmost total column and are separate from the matrix percentages.

icgm_rate_range_mg_dl_per_min.description: The iCGM rate range row label for the row total. Preserve brackets, parentheses, comparison signs, commas, minus signs, and spacing as printed after collapsing repeated whitespace; remove units because the field name supplies them; null is not allowed.

population_age_group.description: The population age group printed in the trend accuracy table title. Preserve comparison symbols, hyphens, digits, and capitalization; collapse repeated whitespace to a single space; null is not allowed.

subjects_n.description: The subject count printed in parentheses in the trend accuracy table title. Emit the integer only, without the leading letter, parentheses, commas, or trailing .0; null is not allowed.

total_paired_icgm_comparator_n.description: The integer printed in the row's rightmost total column for number of paired iCGM-comparator values. Strip commas; emit as an integer; null is not allowed.

wear_location.description: The wear-location label printed in the trend accuracy table title. Preserve exact printed capitalization; collapse repeated whitespace to a single space; null is not allowed.

title: FDA 510(k) Continuous Glucose Monitor Decision Summary Data Export
